US software companies: Microsoft, Oracle, Salesforce, Palantir and the rest.

Homebuilders plus building products, furnishings and home-improvement retailers. A wider housing bet than ITB.

Long-term US government bonds. Rises when long-term rates fall, falls when they rise.
Bonds from companies rated BBB or better. Mostly moves with Treasury yields.
Junk bonds. When it lags LQD, lenders want more pay for risk and credit spreads are widening.
